name: Jesus
summary: The eternal Word of God who becomes flesh, performs miraculous signs, and is crucified and raised to reveal God's glory.

name: John the Baptist
summary: A prophet sent to testify about the coming light, who baptizes and points his own followers toward Jesus.

name: Andrew
summary: One of John the Baptist's disciples who follows Jesus first and brings his brother Simon to meet him.

name: Peter
summary: A fisherman renamed by Jesus who becomes a leading disciple, denies knowing Jesus during the trial, and is later restored.

name: Philip
summary: A disciple from Bethsaida called directly by Jesus, who brings his friend Nathanael to meet him.

name: Nathanael
summary: A skeptical man won over the moment Jesus reveals he saw him under a fig tree before they met.

name: Nicodemus
summary: A Pharisee and ruler of the Jews who visits Jesus by night to ask about being born again, and later helps bury him.

name: The Samaritan Woman
summary: A woman at Jacob's well whose conversation with Jesus about living water leads her whole town to believe in him.

name: Martha
summary: Lazarus's sister who confesses Jesus as the Christ and later serves a meal in Bethany after his resurrection.

name: Mary of Bethany
summary: Lazarus's sister who weeps at her brother's tomb and later anoints Jesus' feet with costly perfume.

name: Lazarus
summary: A close friend of Jesus in Bethany whose death and raising after four days becomes his greatest sign.

name: Thomas
summary: A disciple nicknamed the Twin who doubts the resurrection until he sees and touches Jesus' wounds himself.

name: Judas Iscariot
summary: The disciple who keeps the money bag, objects to Mary's costly gift, and later betrays Jesus to the authorities.

name: Caiaphas
summary: The high priest that year who advises it is better for one man to die for the people, then presides over Jesus' trial.

name: Pontius Pilate
summary: The Roman governor who interrogates Jesus, finds no guilt in him, but ultimately hands him over to be crucified.

name: Barabbas
summary: A robber the crowd chooses to have released instead of Jesus when Pilate offers to free a prisoner.

name: Mary Magdalene
summary: The first person to see the risen Jesus, who discovers the empty tomb and reports the news to the disciples.

name: The Disciple Whom Jesus Loved
summary: An unnamed disciple who reclines next to Jesus at the last supper and receives his mother's care from the cross.

name: Joseph of Arimathea
summary: A secret disciple and member of the council who asks Pilate for Jesus' body and provides a new tomb for burial.
